candidate_l3_description: Converts between raster and vector formats: raster to polygon/point/line or vector to raster.
catalog_description: Creates vector polygons for all connected regions of pixels in the raster sharing a common pixel value. Each polygon is created with an attribute indicating the pixel value of that polygon.
review_reason: GDAL polygonize converts raster regions to vector polygons; legacy-350 has Raster-Vector Conversion.

candidate_l3_description: Converts between raster and vector formats: raster to polygon/point/line or vector to raster.
catalog_description: Converts vector geometries (points, lines and polygons) into a raster image.
review_reason: GDAL rasterize converts vector geometries to raster; same legacy Raster-Vector Conversion class as polygonize.

candidate_l3_description: Adds a spatial index to a feature class to improve spatial query performance.
catalog_description: Creates an index to speed up access to the features in a layer based on their spatial location. Support for spatial index creation is dependent on the layer's data provider.
review_reason: QGIS catalog describes spatial-index creation for query performance; legacy-350 has Add Spatial Index, but it is support/performance rather than analytical output.

catalog_description: This algorithm attempts to create a valid representation of a given invalid geometry without losing any of the input vertices. Already-valid geometries are returned without further intervention. Always outputs multi-geometry layer.NOTE: M values will be dropped from the output.
review_reason: QGIS catalog says invalid geometry repair; legacy-350 has Repair Geometry, absent from stable-94.

candidate_l3_description: Transforms spatial data from one coordinate reference system (CRS) to another including projection and datum transformation.
catalog_description: This algorithm reprojects a vector layer. It creates a new layer with the same features as the input one, but with geometries reprojected to a new CRS.Attributes are not modified by this algorithm.
review_reason: QGIS catalog says vector CRS reprojection; legacy-350 has Project/Reproject, absent from stable-94.

candidate_l3_description: Exports vector features to Shapefile format for data sharing and archiving.
catalog_description: This algorithm creates a new layer with all the selected features in a given vector layer.If the selected layer has no selected features, the newly created layer will be empty.
review_reason: QGIS catalog creates an output layer from selected features; current stable-94 has export-to-shapefile but this operator may be temporary-layer copy/export, so it remains a boundary alias.
